goals.title: A working sheltered bed
goals.requirement: A watered rootbed under an actually supported clear roof, receiving useful light.

goals.title: A useful soft interface
goals.requirement: A moldable fitted porous surface actually supplied water to a growing bed. Any player-chosen surface may do this.

goals.title: Keep the water service
goals.requirement: A currently rigid porous fitted surface actually supplies a currently growing bed; replacement is legal.

goals.title: Useful survey
goals.requirement: Make actual front-on records of beacon and far-marker. They need not share a center on this board.

goals.title: Readable working reference
goals.requirement: A genuine physical observation copy is readable at the dry working bench. Temporary porous material is sufficient; durable alternatives remain legal.

goals.title: Durable reference
goals.requirement: A genuine physical observation copy remains readable in actual wet contact at the wet-display mount; durable watertight local material protects it. Geometrical copies do not create records.

goals.title: Worked surface, new purpose
goals.requirement: An actual surface that earlier supplied useful water while moldable now is durable/watertight and carries a genuine physical observation copy. A replacement can keep the water service.

goals.title: Useful specimen holder
goals.requirement: An actual table-leaf contact sample rests in a supported tray under overhead dust protection with light and open-side air.

goals.title: Keep an actual relief
goals.requirement: A durable watertight surface retains a real leaf-relief contact impression.

goals.title: Publish the survey
goals.requirement: Relay actual front-on beacon and far-marker records to the receiver.

goals.title: Keep a useful conservatory
goals.requirement: At endpoint a watered rootbed has supported clear overhead protection and useful light; original or replacement is valid.

goals.title: Open public approach
goals.requirement: The disclosed public path has no solid body or physical panel cutting its interior; no required garden square.

goals.title: Common-center comparison
goals.requirement: Actual front-on images of A and B from the same lens center establish their perpendicular bearing relationship. One camera or sequential cameras are equally valid.

goals.title: Publish the comparison
goals.requirement: Relay actual A and B records made from their same optical center to the receiver.

goals.title: Conservatory specimen work
goals.requirement: An actual garden-leaf contact sample rests in a supported lit tray under overhead dust protection with open-side air. Sharing an assembly is legal.

goals.title: Keep a durable survey
goals.requirement: A physical copy of an actual common-center survey observation remains readable in actual wet contact at the wet-display mount; durable watertight local material protects it.

response: Two boards share the same geometry and material laws. Inspect all goals; no ordered lock.

recipes.description: Supported frame and actual wheel contact markers; no shrinking or mobility quota.
A cart with a declared future attachment hinge; actual connected bodies retain their dimensions.
Actual two-body camera attached at a real vertical hinge axis to the cart frame.
Lens at origin faces east; recording plate one unit behind. Both real unit bodies.
Seeded tray occupying one actual unit body.
Two-cell supported clear roof. Right panel is hinged at the real seam; no solid interior.
Supported porous roof for a lit dry specimen; no sealed enclosure claim.

laws: Unit lengths; x east, y south, z up. Cardinal exact rigid poses. Unit roots/lenses/plates are solid boxes; panels and frame struts have explicitly zero thickness. No invisible filled interior.

Every actual shape must belong to a geometric touching component reaching z=0. Whole joins select complete poses; solids cannot overlap, boundaries cannot cut solids. Touching and laminates are legal. Unbounded supported apron; no object or material cap.

Whole-object relocation is one action; it preserves every body extent. It clears that object's water/power/light links and seating. No cart setup required. Endpoint support/collision only, not a swept-path simulation.
A declared hinge rotates only its attached subtree about the actual parent-coordinate pivot/axis, preserving dimensions. A hinge elsewhere never shrinks a rigid camera.

A camera needs a lens and a recording plate at exactly one unit behind its center along its local forward direction, with the plate's local +x recording normal pointing in that same direction. Targets must be in front on the opposite-facing cardinal ray. Opaque/diffuse/reflecting intervening shapes block faithful records; clear boundaries transmit. Own selected lens/plate are excluded. Records freeze actual center, heading, target, lens, plate and traversed surfaces.

Overhead clear supported panels protect actual roots from falling dust/rain and pass daylight. Opaque roofs block daylight. Roof protection is not sealed enclosure. Open-sided overhead protection does not seal air: clear and porous roofs both allow side ventilation. A lamp with an actual power link supplies useful local light to its own assembly. No scattering or radiation falloff model.

Water/power/light service links are nonblocking abstract interfaces, not geometric wires/pipes. Water connection needs an actual tube constituent. Tap is inexhaustible. Filter contact must be actively fitted at the disclosed outlet with matching profile and porous surface; water can flow through that selected surface. Moving clears seating and links.

A physical copy is readable in actual wet-site contact only on a locally durable watertight material. An overhead roof does not remove wet mounting contact. At a dry working bench temporary porous recording material is sufficient; a durable alternative remains legal.

Soft useful service is recorded only when the fitted surface supplies a genuinely growing bed. A later role can refer to that actual event, not a born-at identity. Replacements remain valid for continued service.

Blueprint/design copies retain geometry/materials but clear all actual records, events, samples and seating. Physical copying preserves full actual source observations. Observation provenance is never inferred from a receiver or containing host.

Actual physical tool/material operations require the selected actual local surfaces to touch along a face with positive area in the current pose. An optional complete at/rotation moves the material assembly as part of the selected combination. Remote or unrelated host parts cannot substitute. Primitive catalyst capabilities are inexhaustible hand tools; site water, fitting and specimen contact require actual local position.

Take-form copies the selected actual template geometry and profile, not its events. Contact relief uses actual site contact. Transformations retain or change public local properties; no secret recipes. No scarce materials, quotas, continuous time or original-ID goals.

laws: Unit lengths; x east, y south, z up. Cardinal exact rigid poses. Unit roots/lenses/plates are solid boxes; panels and frame struts have explicitly zero thickness. No invisible filled interior.

Every actual shape must belong to a geometric touching component reaching z=0. Whole joins select complete poses; solids cannot overlap, boundaries cannot cut solids. Touching and laminates are legal. Unbounded supported apron; no object or material cap.

Whole-object relocation is one action; it preserves every body extent. It clears that object's water/power/light links and seating. No cart setup required. Endpoint support/collision only, not a swept-path simulation.
A declared hinge rotates only its attached subtree about the actual parent-coordinate pivot/axis, preserving dimensions. A hinge elsewhere never shrinks a rigid camera.

A camera needs a lens and a recording plate at exactly one unit behind its center along its local forward direction, with the plate's local +x recording normal pointing in that same direction. Targets must be in front on the opposite-facing cardinal ray. Opaque/diffuse/reflecting intervening shapes block faithful records; clear boundaries transmit. Own selected lens/plate are excluded. Records freeze actual center, heading, target, lens, plate and traversed surfaces.

Overhead clear supported panels protect actual roots from falling dust/rain and pass daylight. Opaque roofs block daylight. Roof protection is not sealed enclosure. Open-sided overhead protection does not seal air: clear and porous roofs both allow side ventilation. A lamp with an actual power link supplies useful local light to its own assembly. No scattering or radiation falloff model.

Water/power/light service links are nonblocking abstract interfaces, not geometric wires/pipes. Water connection needs an actual tube constituent. Tap is inexhaustible. Filter contact must be actively fitted at the disclosed outlet with matching profile and porous surface; water can flow through that selected surface. Moving clears seating and links.

A physical copy is readable in actual wet-site contact only on a locally durable watertight material. An overhead roof does not remove wet mounting contact. At a dry working bench temporary porous recording material is sufficient; a durable alternative remains legal.

Soft useful service is recorded only when the fitted surface supplies a genuinely growing bed. A later role can refer to that actual event, not a born-at identity. Replacements remain valid for continued service.

Blueprint/design copies retain geometry/materials but clear all actual records, events, samples and seating. Physical copying preserves full actual source observations. Observation provenance is never inferred from a receiver or containing host.

Actual physical tool/material operations require the selected actual local surfaces to touch along a face with positive area in the current pose. An optional complete at/rotation moves the material assembly as part of the selected combination. Remote or unrelated host parts cannot substitute. Primitive catalyst capabilities are inexhaustible hand tools; site water, fitting and specimen contact require actual local position.

Take-form copies the selected actual template geometry and profile, not its events. Contact relief uses actual site contact. Transformations retain or change public local properties; no secret recipes. No scarce materials, quotas, continuous time or original-ID goals.

goals.title: Durable reference
goals.requirement: A genuine physical observation copy remains readable in actual wet contact at the wet-display mount; durable watertight local material protects it. Geometrical copies do not create records.

goals.title: Worked surface, new purpose
goals.requirement: An actual surface that earlier supplied useful water while moldable now is durable/watertight and carries a genuine physical observation copy. A replacement can keep the water service.

goals.title: Useful specimen holder
goals.requirement: An actual table-leaf contact sample rests in a supported tray under overhead dust protection with light and open-side air.

goals.title: Keep an actual relief
goals.requirement: A durable watertight surface retains a real leaf-relief contact impression.

goals.title: Publish the survey
goals.requirement: Relay actual front-on beacon and far-marker records to the receiver.

response: Accepted synthesis; exact current goals available.

goals.title: A working sheltered bed
goals.requirement: A watered rootbed under an actually supported clear roof, receiving useful light.

goals.title: A useful soft interface
goals.requirement: A moldable fitted porous surface actually supplied water to a growing bed. Any player-chosen surface may do this.

goals.title: Keep the water service
goals.requirement: A currently rigid porous fitted surface actually supplies a currently growing bed; replacement is legal.

goals.title: Useful survey
goals.requirement: Make actual front-on records of beacon and far-marker. They need not share a center on this board.
